description: Creates an entity in a game: a THING that exists in the game and makes noise (unit, enemy, building, object, block, character, button or screen). NEVER an action or moment: 'Undo', 'Snap', 'Level complete', 'Jump' are EVENTS of something (of Interface, of Blocks, of the Character), not entities. Inside a folder, it inherits the folder's events. On the site it is a folder with its image and name, holding its own sounds, so to the user say 'the Player's sounds' or 'the Player folder', not 'entity'.

description.description: How it sounds; goes into the prompts.

external_id.description: The engine scene of this thing (e.g. res://player/player.tscn). With it, the plugin sync merges into this entity instead of creating another: create entities before the sync without fear of duplicates.

folder_id.description: Folder (see list_folders). Without it, the entity goes into Sound effects.

game_id.description: The game id, from list_games or create_game.

name.description: The thing's name shown on the site, in the game's language (e.g. Player, Slime, Wooden door). Up to 80 characters.

name: create_entity
title: Create entity
